items.title: How to Get the Most from AI This Summer
items.summary: It's a summer weekend, so NLW goes action-oriented: a walkthrough of Ethan Mollick's refreshed "which AI to use to do stuff" guide, plus the launch of AIDB's choose-your-own-adventure Summer Adventure training.
